Class JdbcWhoPasskeyUserRepository

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.passkey.JdbcWhoPasskeyUserRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.management.PublicKeyCredentialUserEntityRepository
public class JdbcWhoPasskeyUserRepository extends Object implements org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.management.PublicKeyCredentialUserEntityRepository
JDBC implementation of Spring Security's PublicKeyCredentialUserEntityRepository on who_passkey_user. Each row is the WebAuthn user entity of one identity. Its id (the user handle) is stored as Spring stores it, as Bytes.toBase64UrlString().

Spring looks the entity up with findByUsername(String), passing Authentication.getName(), which is the identity id. who creates the entity with create(UUID, String) before Spring looks, so the user handle is 64 random bytes.

The passkey module has no CredentialRemover: who_passkey_user references who_identity with ON DELETE CASCADE, and who_passkey_credential references who_passkey_user the same way, so deleting an identity deletes its passkeys.

  • Method Details

    • create

      public org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.api.PublicKeyCredentialUserEntity create(UUID identityId, String name)
      Returns the identity's user entity, creating it if it does not exist. A new entity's user handle is 64 bytes from SecureRandom; its name and display_name are name. An existing entity is returned unchanged.
      Parameters:
      identityId - the identity
      name - the name the passkey picker shows
      Returns:
      the identity's user entity

    • rename

      public void rename(UUID identityId, String name)
      Sets the name and display_name of the identity's user entity. Does nothing if the identity has none. The user handle is unchanged.
      Parameters:
      identityId - the identity
      name - the name the passkey picker shows

    • save

      public void save(org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.api.PublicKeyCredentialUserEntity userEntity)
      Upserts the entity on its id: inserts it, or updates name and display_name. The identity id comes from the existing row, or for a new entity from its name, as Spring's own registration creates entities named Authentication.getName().
      Specified by:
      save in interface org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.management.PublicKeyCredentialUserEntityRepository
      Parameters:
      userEntity - the entity
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a new entity's name is not an identity id

    • delete

      @Transactional public void delete(org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.api.Bytes id)
      Deletes the entity. Its passkeys are deleted by the foreign key cascade; this method unlinks each of them from the identity first, so no session signed in with one stays valid.
      Specified by:
      delete in interface org.springframework.security.web.webauthn.management.PublicKeyCredentialUserEntityRepository
      Parameters:
      id - the user handle
